SELECT * FROM voice_transcription_jobs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE voice_transcription_jobs SET status='transcribing', attempts=attempts+1, error_code=NULL, updated_at=#{now}, completed_at=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('failed','expired')

UPDATE voice_transcription_jobs SET status=#{status}, transcript=#{transcript}, error_code=#{errorCode}, media_path=#{mediaPath}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} AND status='transcribing'
UPDATE voice_transcription_jobs SET status='expired', error_code=COALESCE(error_code, 'expired'), updated_at=#{now} WHERE status='failed' AND expires_at<=#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM voice_transcription_jobs WHERE media_path IS NOT NULL AND expires_at<=#{now} AND status IN ('failed','expired','succeeded') ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE voice_transcription_jobs SET media_path=NULL, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}
